nodes.Name: BuiltinGenIdeas
nodes.ValueLiteral: []string{"A small library lending service: members borrow and return books, librarians add books and see overdue loans", "An inventory service for a hardware store: products with stock counts, suppliers, and purchase orders that restock products", "A gym membership service: members, plans and checkins; staff can freeze or cancel memberships", "A support ticket tracker: customers open tickets, agents reply to tickets and close them, tags for triage", "An event registration service: events with capacity, attendees register and cancel, a waitlist promotes automatically"}

nodes.Name: GenPipeline
nodes.DocComment:
GenPipeline runs the full Generate pipeline once per idea and aggregates the
WP1 metrics. One Case per idea (pass = plan ok + agent ok + backend builds +
go test passes) plus the aggregate metrics.

nodes.Name: dirCmdOK
nodes.DocComment:
dirCmdOK runs a command in dir and reports success. A missing dir is a
failure (the pipeline was expected to create it).
